elements.description:
A one-time-code field: one box per character, a gliding focus ring, verify / error / success states and a resend
countdown.

properties.name: separator
properties.description: A small dash between the boxes – `true` puts it in the middle, a number after that many boxes

properties.name: numeric
properties.description: Digits only (numeric keyboard on phones); `false` (numeric="false") allows letters too, shown in capitals

properties.name: value
properties.description: The code. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: onComplete
properties.description: Called once the last box is filled – typed, pasted or autofilled. May return a promise (the check)

properties.name: status
properties.description: The check's state. Unset, it follows the promise `onComplete` returns

properties.name: errorMessage
properties.description: Shown below the boxes while the status is "error": text, or an element (cloned)

properties.name: clearOnError
properties.description: Clears the boxes shortly after an error, ready for the next try (clear-on-error="false" keeps them)

properties.name: successLabel
properties.description: Text in the pill after a successful check

properties.name: resendable
properties.description: Shows "Resend code" below the boxes once the countdown is over (fires tc-resend)

properties.name: resendIn
properties.description: Seconds until the code can be resent

properties.name: align
properties.description: Center the boxes and the lines below them

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for form submission – the code is submitted under it

properties.name: required
properties.description: A form needs a code before it submits

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.description: Focus the input when the field first renders

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name of the field (used when there's no `labelledBy` and no page <label for>)

properties.name: labelledBy
properties.description: Id of a visible label (a heading or <label>) that names the field – preferred over `label` (WCAG 2.5.3, 3.3.2)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The user changed the code ({ value }: OtpValueChange); cancelable

props.name: value
props.description: The code. Controlled when defined; otherwise the field keeps its own, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown below the boxes while `status` is "error"

props.name: onResend
props.description: Shows "Resend code" below the boxes once the countdown is over

changelog: otp-input, dropzone and stepper-form's tags and choices are form controls (ElementInternals): they submit under `name`, honour `required`, reset and a disabled fieldset, and are named by a page `<label for>`.
